question: A 5-man group made up of one tank, one healer, and three DPS is doing a dungeon that was just released in World of Warcraft. Two are plate wearers and two are cloth wearers. At the final boss, both the tank and the healer are casting holy spells. Ice and fire are being used, each one by a different DPS. A bear from the group is attacking the boss. Metamorphosis is cast. The Kilt of the Forgotten One drops as loot, but no one can use it. If all classes were using their class abilities and all classes are unique, what are the five classes in the group in alphabetical order separated by commas?
ground_truth: Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock

history.name: WoW_Mechanics_Expert
history.content:
Objective: derive the five unique classes from the given clues. Approach:
- Map role clues: Tank and healer both casting holy suggests Paladin and Priest.
- Damage types: Ice and fire by separate DPS; ice can be Frost Death Knight, fire can be Warlock (Destruction).
- Bear attacking: likely a Hunter's bear pet rather than a Druid (to avoid leather, consistent with the kilt being unusable if it's leather).
- Metamorphosis: Warlock (Demonology) fits.
- Armor distribution: need exactly 2 plate and 2 cloth; the remaining slot can be mail if the kilt is leather.
Candidate classes to validate: Paladin (plate), Priest (cloth), Death Knight (plate), Warlock (cloth), Hunter (mail).

history.name: LogicExpert
history.content:
Constraints restated:
- 1 tank, 1 healer, 3 DPS; all classes unique.
- Armor: exactly 2 plate, exactly 2 cloth.
- Tank/healer cast holy: Paladin + Priest.
- DPS: one uses ice (Frost DK), one uses fire (Warlock), bear is attacking (Hunter pet), Metamorphosis (Warlock).
- Kilt of the Forgotten One is unusable: interpret as a leather item so no leather wearer present (excludes Druid/Rogue).
Check candidate set: {Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock}.
- Armor counts: plate = Paladin + DK (2), cloth = Priest + Warlock (2), mail = Hunter (1). Distribution matches.
- Roles: Tank Paladin (holy), Healer Priest (holy), DPS DK (ice), Warlock (fire + Meta), Hunter (bear pet).
This set satisfies all clues. I'll prepare a structured summary and verify counts programmatically.

No contradictions detected.

history.content:
Item eligibility check: Kilt of the Forgotten One has been referenced historically as a leather kilt; if no leather wearers are present, "no one can use it" holds. With Hunter (mail) instead of Druid (leather), the kilt remains unusable.
Cross-check: All clues satisfied by {Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock}. Ready to finalize.
